```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggsci)
library(ggrepel)
library(cowplot)
library(grid) # unit(), grob

```


# All
```{r}
# 读取三国的 scenario 列，做并集
scn_cn <- read_excel("Fig 4 China.xlsx",        sheet = "Fig 4a1", skip = 38) |> select(scenario)
scn_kr <- read_excel("Fig 4 South Korea.xlsx",  sheet = "Fig 4b1", skip = 43) |> select(scenario)
scn_za <- read_excel("Fig 4 South Africa.xlsx", sheet = "Fig 4c1", skip = 44) |> select(scenario)

scen_levels_raw <- c(scn_cn$scenario, scn_kr$scenario, scn_za$scenario) |> unique() |> as.character()

# 期望顺序（若不存在则自动忽略）
pref <- c("BAU","Best (with BG)","Best (without BG)","P1","P2","P3","P4","P5")
scen_levels <- c(pref[pref %in% scen_levels_raw], setdiff(scen_levels_raw, pref))

# === 全局主题 ===
base_theme <- theme(
  legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "line"),
  legend.key.width  = unit(0.6, "line"),
  legend.position   = c(0.02, 0),
  legend.justification = c(0,0),
  legend.background = element_blank(),
  plot.margin = margin(l = 0.5, unit = "cm"),
  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  plot.title = element_text(size=16, hjust = 0.5)
) + theme(text = element_text(size = 16))

# === 情景图例标签映射 ===
scen_labels <- setNames(scen_levels, scen_levels)
if ("P1" %in% names(scen_labels)) scen_labels["P1"] <- "Energy efficiency improvement"
if ("P2" %in% names(scen_labels)) scen_labels["P2"] <- "Aquaculture transformation"
if ("P3" %in% names(scen_labels)) scen_labels["P3"] <- "Variety evolution"
if ("P4" %in% names(scen_labels)) scen_labels["P4"] <- "Feed substation"
if ("P5" %in% names(scen_labels)) scen_labels["P5"] <- "Infrastructure upgrade"


```
# China
```{r}
rdbu <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(name = "RdBu", n = 9)
mycol <- rdbu[c(1:3,4)]

d1 <- read_excel("Fig 4 China.xlsx", sheet = "Fig 4a1", skip = 38)
d2 <- read_excel("Fig 4 China.xlsx", sheet = "Fig 4a2", skip = 10)
d2$Process2 <- factor(d2$Process, levels = c("Infra.&Equip.","Energy","Transport","Feed"))

d1$scenario <- factor(d1$scenario, levels = scen_levels)

p1a <- d1 %>%
  ggplot(aes(Year, mean/1000, group = scenario)) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_col(data = d2, position = "stack", width = 2,
           aes(Year, CO2/1000, fill = Process2), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(color = scenario), linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-4.8e2, 3e2)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mycol) +
  scale_color_npg(limits = scen_levels, drop = FALSE, labels = scen_labels[scen_levels]) +
  labs(fill = NULL, y = "", title = "China") +
  guides(color = "none", fill = "none") +
  base_theme

p1b <- d1 %>%
  filter(Year == 2050) %>%
  ggplot(aes(scenario, mean/1000, color = scenario)) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_linerange(aes(min = min/1000, max = max/1000), linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-4.8e2, 3e2)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1, hjust = 1.05)) +
  scale_color_npg(limits = scen_levels, drop = FALSE, labels = scen_labels[scen_levels]) +
  guides(color = "none", fill = "none") +
  labs(title = "Uncertainty in 2050", y = NULL, x = NULL) +
  base_theme +
  theme(axis.line.y = element_blank())

p1 <- plot_grid(p1a, p1b, align = "h", axis = "b", rel_widths = c(1, 0.8))


```

# 拼图

```{r}
# 主图
all_plots <- plot_grid(p1, p2, p3,
                       ncol = 1, align = "v", axis = "l",
                       labels = c("a","b","c"))

# --- 过程图例 ---
legend_process <- get_legend(
  ggplot(d2, aes(x = Year, y = CO2/1000, fill = Process2)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mycol) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(
        title = NULL,
        override.aes = list(shape = 22, size = 4)
      )
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "left",
      legend.key.width  = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      text = element_text(size = 16)
    )
)

# --- 最终拼图：只放过程图例 ---
final_plot <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(all_plots, x = 0, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1) +
  draw_grob(
    legend_process,
    x = 0.1, y = 0.15, width = 0.25, height = 0.2,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0
  )

final_plot

# --- 导出 ---
scale_factor <- 1.35
w_in <- (463/90) * scale_factor   # 去掉右边空白
h_in <- (666/90) * scale_factor

ggsave("figure 4.png", final_plot, width = w_in, height = h_in, dpi = 1200)
ggsave("figure 4.pdf", final_plot, width = w_in, height = h_in)



```
